data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 349ec90f7e

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md should close bug tickets using \`ticket transition <id> open closed --reason="Fixed: <summary>"\` per rule:bug-close-with-code. tests/skills/test-no-chained-ticket-close.sh asserts a grep pattern matching either \`ticket transition.*closed.*--reason\` or \`--reason.*Fixed\` in sprint SKILL.md.

#### Actual Behavior

Sprint SKILL.md lines 2225-2227 use the separate-comment-then-transition pattern:

\`\`\`
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <id> "Fixed: <summary>"
.claude/scripts/dso ticket transition <id> open closed
\`\`\`

test_bug_close_uses_reason_flag_in_sprint fails with exit 1 because no \`--reason\` reference exists in the SKILL.md file. This pre-existing failure blocks the test gate on any commit that touches indexed source files (e.g., ticket-lib-api.sh).
data.title: [sprint-SKILL]: bug close uses separate comment+transition -> test_bug_close_uses_reason_flag_in_sprint fails
